summary: Master the art of investing in Real Estate Investment Trusts with our expert-led training course. Gain the knowledge to enhance your financial portfolio now!
lede: Real estate investment trust (REIT) training covers how these investments generate income and how investors assess their value and risks. It is for professionals evaluating or managing real estate allocations who need to compare REIT sectors, interpret financial statements and distribution sustainability, assess pricing and risk drivers, and prepare clear allocation recommendations and investment memos.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals involved in evaluating and managing real estate investments across various sectors.
audience: Pension fund, endowment, and SACCO investment committee
modules: REIT Fundamentals and Why They Matter
Understanding REIT Sectors and Property Economics
Reading REIT Financials Without Getting Lost
Valuation and Pricing Logic for REITs
Due Diligence and Investment Decision Workflow
REITs for Institutions, Public Sector, and NGOs
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of investment principles and financial statements. Prior exposure to real estate or capital markets is beneficial but not mandatory.
